title: "CENTRAL PARK WEATHER"
output:
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: rows
    vertical_layout: fill
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(p8105.datasets)
library(plotly)
```

```{r data, include = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

# Importing NOAA data
noaa_flex <- read.csv("data/ny_noaa.csv")

# Filtering to Central Park, variable cleaning
noaa_flex_clean <- noaa_flex %>%
  filter(id == "USW00094728") %>%
  mutate(
    year = year(date),
    month = month(date, label=TRUE),
    day = day(date)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    tmax = (1.8 * tmax / 10) + 32,
    tmin = (1.8 * tmin / 10) + 32,
    t_avg = (tmax + tmin)/2,
    prcp = 0.0393701 * prcp / 10,
    snow = 0.0393701 * snow,
    snwd = 0.0393701 * snwd,
    rain_snow = prcp + snow
    ) %>%
  select(-date) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      c(year, day, prcp, snow, snwd, tmax, tmin), as.numeric),
    id = as.factor(id)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    season = case_when(
      month %in% c("Dec", "Jan", "Feb") ~ "Winter",
      month %in% c("Mar", "Apr", "May") ~ "Spring",
      month %in% c("Jun", "Jul", "Aug") ~ "Summer",
      month %in% c("Sep", "Oct", "Nov") ~ "Fall"
    ),
    season = factor(
      season,
      levels = c("Fall", "Winter", "Spring", "Summer"))
  )

# Historical temp and rain/snow data
historical_weather_noaa <- noaa_flex_clean %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_prcp = mean(prcp, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_snow = mean(snow, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_snwd = mean(snwd, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_tmax = mean(tmax, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_tmin = mean(tmin, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Data cleaning for violin plot
noaa_violin <- noaa_flex_clean %>%
  filter(rain_snow > 0) %>%
  mutate(
    sqrt_rain_snow = sqrt(rain_snow)
    )

```

Column {data-width=650}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

###

```{r, warning = FALSE}

# Violin plot of seasonal temp distribution
plot_ly(
  data = noaa_violin,
  x = ~season,
  y = ~sqrt_rain_snow,
  color = ~season,
  colors = c(
    "Fall" = "#F4A460",
    "Winter" = "#6C9BCF",
    "Spring" = "#ee9dceff",
    "Summer" = "#8BCF8B"
  ),
  type = "violin",
  box = list(visible = TRUE),
  meanline = list(visible = TRUE),
  points = FALSE
) %>%
  layout(
    title = "Distribution of Total Precipitation by Season",
    xaxis = list(
      title = "Season"
    ),
    yaxis = list(
      title = "Rainfall + Snowfall (in)",
      tickvals = sqrt(c(0, 0.5, 2, 4, 8, 16, 25)),
      ticktext = c("0", "0.5", "2", "4", "8", "16", "25"),
      range = c(0, 5)
      ),
    showlegend = FALSE
  )

```

###

```{r, warning = FALSE}

# Box plot of monthly avg temp distribution
plot_ly(
  data = noaa_flex_clean, 
  x = ~month,
  y = ~t_avg,
  type = "box",
  color = ~month,
  colors = c(
    "Jan" = "#536D9E",
    "Feb" = "#6C9BCF",
    "Mar" = "#75C9C3",
    "Apr" = "#72B7A0",
    "May" = "#8BCF8B",
    "Jun" = "#F9D65C",
    "Jul" = "#F4A460",
    "Aug" = "#F9D65C",
    "Sep" = "#8BCF8B",
    "Oct" = "#72B7A0",
    "Nov" = "#75C9C3",
    "Dec" = "#6C9BCF"
    )
  ) %>%
  layout(
    title = "Temperature Distribution by Month",
    xaxis = list(title = "Month"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Average Temperature (°F)"),
    showlegend = FALSE
  )

```

Column {data-width=350}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### 

```{r, warning = FALSE}

# Bar/line plot of yearly temp/rain/snow data
plot_ly(
  data = historical_weather_noaa,
  x = ~year) %>%
  add_bars(
    y = ~mean_prcp,
    name = "Rainfall",
    marker = list(color = "#75c8c3ff"),
    yaxis = "y",
    showgrid = FALSE,
    zeroline = FALSE
  ) %>%
  add_bars(
    y = ~mean_snow,
    name = "Snowfall",
    marker = list(color = "#6c9bcfff"),
    yaxis = "y",
    showgrid = FALSE,
    zeroline = FALSE
  ) %>%
  add_bars(
    y = ~mean_snwd,
    name = "Snowpack",
    marker = list(color = "#536D9E"),
    yaxis = "y",
    showgrid = FALSE,
    zeroline = FALSE
  ) %>%
  add_lines(
    y = ~mean_tmax,
    name = "Maximum Temperature",
    line = list(
      color = "#F4A460",
      width = 3,
      shape = "spline",
      smoothing = 1.3
      ),
    yaxis = "y2",
    showgrid = FALSE,
    zeroline = FALSE
  ) %>%
  add_lines(
    y = ~mean_tmin,
    name = "Minimum Temperature",
    line = list(
      color = "#72B7A0",
      width = 3,
      shape = "spline",
      smoothing = 1.3
      ),
    yaxis = "y2"
  ) %>%
  layout(
    title = "Average Weather Over Time",
    xaxis = list(title = "Year"),
    yaxis = list(
      title = "Average Precipitation (in)",
      side = "right"
    ),
    yaxis2 = list(
      title = "Average Temperature (°F)",
      overlaying = "y",
      side = "left",
      showgrid = FALSE,
      zeroline = FALSE
    ),
    barmode = "group",
    legend = list(
      orientation = "v",
      x = 1.1,
      xanchor = "left",
      y = 0.5,
      yanchor = "middle",
      bgcolor = "rgba(255,255,255,0.7)",
      font = list(size = 11)
      )
    )

```
